_comment: Observed Tesseract OCR misreadings of chemical formulas from the sample image labels (Phase 2 spot-check). Formula parsing (Phase 4) and matching (Phase 5) must be robust to these, since forbidden_ingredients.csv contains formula entries (e.g. H2O2, C6H6, C8H10N4O2) that a scanned product could contain.

samples.note: leading C misread as euro sign, O misread as 0
